@colibri/contract-bindings.reason: Add the default-on includeColibri generation option and --no-colibri CLI switch to omit Core convenience re-exports.
@colibri/contract-bindings.apiReview: The optional boolean preserves existing output by default. Opting out removes the convenience module, generated client re-exports and fresh package subpath; Core remains required and the writer still preserves existing files and scaffolds.

@colibri/core.reason: Add granular frontend entrypoints and standalone contract reads through existing pipelines.
@colibri/core.apiReview: Additive exports preserve existing clients, constructor identity, process behavior and pipeline composition; thin steps import their own processes.

@colibri/react.reason: Introduce headless React bindings for the Colibri SDK.
@colibri/react.apiReview: Initial provider, connection, query, contract, transaction, assets, events, SEP and session APIs. Ecosystem adapters are isolated under /ecosystem/freighter and /ecosystem/stellar-wallets-kit; the unreleased preview removes Freighter from the general /wallets entrypoint and derives supported vendor signatures from upstream types. Disconnect notifications and rejected network updates terminate observation until explicit reconnection; new private lifecycle helpers preserve the public method signatures.
